t: You're on Great Marlborough Street, a thoroughfare in Soho. It runs east from Regent Street, past Carnaby Street, towards Noel Street. The street takes its name from John Churchill, the first Duke of Marlborough. He was a British army officer and statesman who rose from a gentry family, serving as a page at the Stuart court before earning advancement through his courage and diplomatic skill. He is known for never having lost a battle.
